dslRule:
<!id: styledtext.drawbackground.to.gc.fillrectangle>
<!description: Replace StyledText.drawBackground with GC.fillRectangle for direct drawing, particularly when GC background is already set. This addresses rendering issues and clarifies intent.
Ensure the StyledText and GC instances are correctly identified by their types.>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: swt, drawing, api-modernization>

$styledText.drawBackground($gc, $x, $y, $width, $height) :: instanceof($styledText, "org.eclipse.swt.custom.StyledText") && instanceof($gc, "org.eclipse.swt.graphics.GC")
=> $gc.fillRectangle($x, $y, $width, $height)
;;
summary: Replaces calls to `StyledText.drawBackground()` with `GC.fillRectangle()` when the target is `StyledText` and `GC` for direct background filling, as `GC.setBackground()` is typically called before.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
